diagnosis.reported_failure: All 13 contracts suites fail during registration, before test execution, with undefined config or no current suite. Other imported packages using the same inherited @effect/vitest patch reach their tests.
static_evidence: The pre-refresh pnpm-lock.yaml importer and snapshot entries distinguish contracts' 26.6.5 peer context from the vendor runner/shared 24.12.4 peer context.

readlink/realpath of the installed @effect/vitest, vite-plus and transitive vitest packages confirms distinct physical module identities for contracts and the vendor runner; shared matches the runner.
The inherited patch makes @effect/vitest import and re-export vite-plus/test. That installed entrypoint re-exports vitest, which resolves within its own peer-specific package graph.
The installed Vite+ CLI resolves its bundled Vitest binary first, and its defineConfig integration documents the need for the runner and registration API to share physical module identity.
The frozen upstream lock provenance resolves contracts and the other imported packages with @types/node 24.12.4 and esbuild 0.28.2. The contracts source manifest does not itself declare @types/node.
diagnosis.root_cause: [INFERENCE] The differing pnpm peer contexts split runner state from contracts' describe/it.effect registration state. Equal package versions and equal patch contents do not imply equal module identity.

applied_patches.change: Add devDependencies.@types/node = catalog:, using the existing 24.12.4 catalog entry so contracts resolves the same Vite+/Vitest peer graph as the vendor runner.
applied_patches.unchanged: Package exports, effect runtime dependency, upstream test script, @effect/vitest version/patch and vite-plus version are unchanged. esbuild is already 0.28.2 in both observed graphs, so no additional esbuild dependency or root build-tool override is introduced.

applied_patches.change: Set resolve.dedupe to @effect/vitest and vite-plus so transformed test imports use the harness root's test helper and Vite+ instances rather than an importer-specific copy.
applied_patches.unchanged: Keep vite-plus/test/config and defineConfig integration; do not alias bare vitest or its internals, inline or replace registration APIs, change module externalization, suppress exceptions, narrow discovery, skip suites, relax assertions, add retries, or change environment/timeouts/fake timers/setup files/allowOnly behavior.

parent_integration.source_manifest_and_shared_ledgers: Parent-owned; register these two local deviations without altering the frozen upstream source records.
